metrics.Nu_bar_cavity_discrete_method_difference: signed primary minus section-trapezoid; use the explicit absolute/relative fields for diagnostics
metrics.Nu_bar_cavity_method_relative_difference: abs(Nu_bar_cavity), where Nu_bar_cavity is the primary cell-volume quadrature
metrics.paper_Nu_discretization: walls: B1 orthogonal patch snGrad; internal vertical faces: saved volume flux phi times linearly interpolated theta plus two-cell orthogonal conductive flux integrated with face area; cavity: cell-volume U*theta quadrature plus exact imposed-wall conductive integral 1
metrics.Nu_hot_local_extrema_method: fixed local quartic through five adjacent face-centre values; derivative root inside the local interval; endpoint evaluated by the same quartic only when the five-point window touches it

Nu_bar_cavity.error_legacy_semantics: signed relative difference; do not use for Gate judgement

Nu_bar_half.error_legacy_semantics: signed relative difference; do not use for Gate judgement

Nu_bar_0.error_legacy_semantics: signed relative difference; do not use for Gate judgement

Nu_hot_local_max.error_legacy_semantics: signed relative difference; do not use for Gate judgement

Nu_hot_local_max_Z.error_legacy_semantics: signed position difference; do not use for Gate judgement

Nu_hot_local_min.error_legacy_semantics: signed relative difference; do not use for Gate judgement

Umax.error_legacy_semantics: signed relative difference; do not use for Gate judgement

Wmax.error_legacy_semantics: signed relative difference; do not use for Gate judgement

Wmax_X.error_legacy_semantics: signed position difference; do not use for Gate judgement

Nu_bar_1.note: Table V contains no independent cold-wall mean reference

metrics.B1_method: OpenFOAM v6 fixedValue patch snGrad formula (Twall-Towner)*deltaCoeffs, evaluated from actual patch and owner-cell T; orthogonal mesh deltaCoeffs=2/h; uniform face-area average. Used after postProcess grad(T) failed in the installed v6 OSHA1 dictionary-digest path.
metrics.B2_method: independent quadratic through Tw,T1,T2 at inward coordinates 0,h/2,3h/2; derivative (-8Tw/3+3T1-T2/3)/h; Nu_hot=-L*dT/ds/DeltaT and Nu_cold=+L*dT/ds/DeltaT; face-centre rows only
metrics.centreline_method: linear interpolation from two bracketing cell-centre lines to exact centreline, then 4097 uniform points including no-slip endpoints

continuity.mass_relation: rho0 is constant, so normalized mass- and volume-divergence metrics are identical; solver phi is volume flux

symmetry.method: paired cell centres under 180-degree rotation; RMS defect divided by RMS original theta or in-plane velocity magnitude
